newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai police kill five drugs traffickers.
newsitem.headline: Thai police kill five drugs traffickers.

text.p: Police in northern Thailand shot dead five suspected drugs traffickers on Wednesday, officials said.
Police said the alleged amphetamine traffickers were killed during a shootout in Uthai Thani province, about 200 km (125 miles) north of Bangkok.
The government has declared war on drugs, and police said more than 20 alleged amphetamine traffickers had been shot dead this year.
Police last November summarily executed six suspected amphetamine traffickers in central Suphan Buri province shortly after their surrender, sparking a public outcry.
